about: A bot's name in a message is a link to its chat, on the web page (botNameLinks in public/app.js) and in the Android app (BotNames in android/shared).
cases: { name, bots, text, links }. bots: [{ id, name }], the bots that exist. links: the names found in text, in order, as [where it starts, its text, the bot's id].

The text of a link is the name as written, plus one of the endings Polish gives it (owi ami ach em om ów ie ze a u y i e ę ą); case as the name has it; a whole word; the longest name first; a name two bots share, a name of one letter and a name after @, / or - are not links.
